youtube.title: Why does a soda bottle bottom have feet? #shorts
youtube.description:
Why does a soda bottle bottom have five little feet? Fizzy drinks are packed with gas that pushes on the bottle about as hard as the air in a car tyre. Pressure pushes plastic towards round, like a balloon, so a flat bottom would bulge out and the bottle would wobble. That's why still water bottles can be flat, but fizzy drink bottles get a curvy 'petaloid' base: the curves take the push and five bumps become the feet it stands on.
